title: Problem (v1 error response)
description: Every non-2xx response: RFC 9457 Problem Details, Content-Type application/problem+json. Branch on `code` (stable), not on `title`/`detail` (human text). `retryable: true` means the SAME request may be resent later, which is safe because creation is idempotent. Known codes and statuses: INVALID_JSON 400, VALIDATION_FAILED 400, UNAUTHENTICATED 401, FORBIDDEN 403, NOT_FOUND 404, PARCEL_REF_CONFLICT 409, LOCKER_OFFLINE 409 (retryable, Retry-After), PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE 413, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE 415, LOCKER_NOT_FOUND 422, INTERNAL 500 (retryable), UNAVAILABLE 503 (retryable, Retry-After). New codes may be added within v1; treat unknown codes by their HTTP status.

requestId.description: Quote this when contacting support; also returned as the X-Request-Id header.
